entity: US federal place names (GNIS) that still say "Negro"
what_we_add: the 2020-23 comparison, 641 "Squaw" names changed vs at least 41 "Negro" or n-word ones; 105 names with the n-word listed as an older name
why: Atmos (Feb 2022) counts 469 GNIS features still carrying the word, 7% from our 438, same finding. CRS and Interior put the Squaw renamings at about 650-657, near our 641. No source sets the two renaming counts side by side or counts n-word older names.
